title: 1:1 prep - Ethan Wong
content:
Purpose: quick sync before Eng-Manager 1:1. Focus on KV cache refactor status, recent perf/regression alerts, career/check-in, and small blockers I can unblock between now and next week.

Quick context (to self):
- Ethan is driving KV-cache refactor (INF-3421). Goal: reduce repeated prefix compute and reduce tail latency for small-chat workloads.
- Last week: benchmark run showed 12% p99 regression on long-context suite after quantization changes. Suspect kernel selection fallback for int8.
- CI flakiness on windows-emu test is noisy \u2014 Ethan triaged flaky test but needs infra help to stabilize.
- Career note: Ethan expressed interest in ownership opportunities (project lead) and mentoring more juniors.

Agenda (30 min)
1) Quick personal check-in (3\u20134 min) \u2014 energy, bandwidth, any time off coming up
2) Status update on KV cache refactor (8\u201310 min)
   - What\u2019s merged vs blocked? Any surprise regressions?
   - Test coverage gaps + perf regressions details (bench numbers)
   - Plan for rollback / mitigation if p99 stays high after next patch
3) Blockers and unblock requests (6 min)
   - CI flakiness (windows-emu) \u2014 need SRE/release-engineering support ticket?
   - Access to profiling GPU infra for full long-context runs (priority lab slot)
4) Career/Development (6 min)
   - Interest in project lead role for cache work \u2014 what support do you need? Mentorship plan?
   - Pairing/mentoring schedule with Priya if available
5) Action items and next steps (2-3 min)

Prep notes / prompts for Ethan (things to ask):
- Can you give the one-minute summary of the regression (what changed, how measured)?
- Which commit range introduced the p99 increase? Was it quantization kernel or scheduler change?
- Do you have a minimal repro or flamegraph we can show to infra? If not, prioritize creating one this week.
- Who do you want me to loop in from release-eng/sre? I can set up the ticket and ping James.
- If the perf hit persists, are you comfortable shipping with a conservative fallback (force fp16 path) for the next deploy window? Pros/cons?

Notes to capture in meeting (fill live):
- KV cache refactor: branch, PR number, blocking CI failures, target canary date
- Bench numbers: baseline vs current (token throughput, p50/p95/p99, memory usage)
- Action owners and due dates

Current known issues (summary):
- p99 regression on long-context quantized path after kernel selector change (INF-3490).
- Windows-emu test flakes: intermittent timeouts in integration-test-15. Ethan suspects test harness timing; release-eng to diagnose.
- Need longer-run cluster booking for long-context perf runs (request 8-hour slot on gpu-batch-1).

Proposed immediate actions (if we agree in 1:1):
- A1: Ethan to produce a minimal repro + profiler trace by Fri 2026-02-27 (owner: Ethan)
- A2: I (Amanda) to raise a release-eng ticket and loop James + SRE to look at windows-emu flakes by Mon 2026-03-01 (owner: Amanda)
- A3: Switch canary config to fp16 fallback if repro not ready before next canary (owner: Amanda + release-eng)
- A4: Schedule weekly pairing sessions between Ethan and Priya (mentor) \u2014 start next Tue (owner: Ethan)

Longer-term / career items to discuss (future 1:1s):
- Outline a project-lead proposal for KV cache refactor: scope, risks, milestones, cross-team dependencies (due in two weeks).
- Public speaking: encourage giving a short brown-bag on quantization pitfalls next quarter.

Unresolved questions (things I should follow up on):
- Is the perf delta reproducible on internal long-run cluster (or only on ours)?
- Does telemetry show tail allocations spike correlated with the regression? (ask observability team)
- Can we get a short-term budget for extended bench runs if needed? Finance OK?

Follow-up after meeting (template to save):
- Short note to Ethan summarizing actions + owners (send same day)
- Create JIRA subtask under INF-3421 for repro trace and link PR
- Add canary fallback note to deployment runbook

Misc scratch (do not need to show):
- Possible Slack ping: "@james please take a look at INF-3490 windows-emu flakes?"
- Keep an eye on PR #1289 test matrix changes \u2014 they might have tweaked selector order.

End of prep. Keep it lightweight, focus on unblock + clear owner tasks.
